name: Kieu LeetCode Video Skill
description: Agent skill that produces and QA-checks Kieu Studio problem-solving videos for LeetCode problems: every official example, rejected approaches and a correctness argument before code, a 10-second thinking pause, Python 3, Remotion and local VoiceStudio narration, with a Median of Two Sorted Arrays (LeetCode #4) reference episode.

quickstart.title: Use in Codex or Claude Code
steps: Open this repository in the agent
Ask: Use the kieu-leetcode-video skill to build a video for LeetCode #N

requirements.install: Clone the repository or run 'kieu-open-resources install-skill'
